Find stations nearest a municipality seat

Source: R/nearest.R
inmet_nearest.Rd

Ranks stations by great-circle (haversine) distance from each municipality's seat.

Usage

inmet_nearest(muni, n = 1, max_km = NULL, state = NULL, status = NULL)

Arguments

muni

One or more seven-digit IBGE municipality codes or municipality names.

n

Maximum number of stations to return per municipality.

max_km

Optional maximum distance in kilometres.

state

Optional two-letter state abbreviation for name matching. Either one value for every muni or one value per muni; use NA to skip an element.

status

Optional station statuses to keep: any of "operating", "broken" and "closed". See inmet_stations() for their meaning. NULL keeps every station.

Value

A tibble with the station metadata from inmet_stations(), distance_km, and a first column code_muni_query with the IBGE code each row answers. Rows follow the order of muni, then distance.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
inmet_nearest("Campinas", n = 3)
inmet_nearest(c(3550308, 3304557), status = "operating")
}
